claims.assertion: Anéeka says the Van Allen belts are not a solid dome; atmospheric layers can reflect radio waves depending on frequency.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She compares this to long-distance ship radio.

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes Earth as an irregular geoid; she links its uneven shape to surface gravity and magnetic anomalies.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She calls it potato-shaped as a rough analogy.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says atmospheric layers move in different directions but rotate with Earth; the atmosphere fades gradually, with no physical boundary to space.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the boundary is set by convention.
